incidents.signature: A marker was committed without running the identity checker on the exact tree.

incidents.title: A kill rehearsal met its timeout but nobody checked what the killed process left behind
incidents.rule: In a kill rehearsal, inspect the leftovers, and state the temporary directory setting the sweep depends on.
incidents.signature: A rehearsal passed on elapsed time while the leftovers of the killed run were unexamined.

incidents.title: A test fixture name collided with a framework built-in and only collection revealed it
incidents.rule: Run the framework list command on each new helper before its activation review.
incidents.signature: A helper looked fine in review and failed to load in every spec that imported it.

incidents.title: A split-ownership root could not activate because identity had no registry support
incidents.rule: A root split by the registry needs registry-aware identity before its source row can activate.
incidents.signature: The identity checker rejected a root whose file had been reassigned to another row.

incidents.title: A spec used import.meta under a package that loads specs as CommonJS
incidents.rule: Check the module form of the host package before using import.meta in a spec.
incidents.signature: A module-form feature worked in the author mind and would fail when the spec first loaded.

incidents.title: A second reader of the same registry file was at risk of replacing the first
incidents.rule: One parser per shared file format, reviewed with a mutant and a malformed-input case.
incidents.signature: Two rows each needed to parse the same assignments file.

incidents.title: An activation was tied to an unreviewed successor and had to be re-ruled
incidents.rule: Do not tie the activation of a reviewed revision to an unreviewed successor.
incidents.signature: A shipped revision waited on a later revision that had not been reviewed.

incidents.title: Landing a revision beside a supersession edge broke identity on main
incidents.rule: Run the identity checker after every landing, not only after markers; resolve supersession sources only among earlier revisions.
incidents.signature: The landing script passed while the identity checker was red on main.

incidents.title: A chained amend reworded the previous commit after a failed revert
incidents.rule: Chain an amend only with && after a step whose success is checked, and confirm the HEAD subject before amending.
incidents.signature: A revert failed on an invalid flag and the next chained step changed the wrong commit.

incidents.title: Acceptance ran bare vitest while the real gate ran setup then the FAST runner
incidents.rule: Acceptance must run the same commands preship runs, otherwise a green merge looks red or a red one looks green.
incidents.signature: A row merge looked red under the acceptance script and green under preship, or the reverse.

incidents.title: A reverted and re-landed QA revision got its marker approved at the wrong commit
incidents.rule: When a reverted revision is re-landed after an older copy became active, approve its marker at the re-land commit.
incidents.signature: The identity checker compared old active bytes at the approved commit.

incidents.title: A shell variable followed by a colon and a letter became a history modifier
incidents.rule: In zsh, write the braces form of a variable before a colon.
incidents.signature: A shell string produced a truncated value without an error.

incidents.title: A conditional omission could hide behind a helper, an alias or an early return
incidents.rule: Forbid conditional omission anywhere, with the same alias resolution as describe.
incidents.signature: A hygiene rule allowed omissions that took registrations out of a suite.

incidents.title: A revision marker added a second edge to bytes the previous marker already claimed
incidents.rule: Run the identity checker on a scratch clone before committing a marker, and take the edge from the newest pending earlier copy.
incidents.signature: The identity check went red with an old digest mismatch on a marker that looked complete.

incidents.title: Disjoint project discovery did not stop a suite from running twice
incidents.rule: A test that launches a runner must run it on a probe file, not the whole suite.
incidents.signature: One stage doubled its cases and its time.

incidents.title: A garbage collection test with a moved clock reaped the outer tier own live database
incidents.rule: A test that reaps shared resources must run before the outer run owns any.
incidents.signature: A test removed a database that belonged to the run that was executing it.

incidents.title: A tracked file rewritten per tool mode could not stay clean in both tiers
incidents.rule: Do not track a file a tool rewrites per mode; generate it before the check that needs it.
incidents.signature: Two modes of one tool wrote different bytes to a tracked file.

incidents.title: A generator default module augmentation made its committed output fail the type check
incidents.rule: Place generated type augmentation where the augmented module lives.
incidents.signature: Generated output failed to type check in the package where it landed.

incidents.title: A clean-tree gate failed on a fixture synthetic repo before the behavior under test
incidents.rule: A clean-tree gate applies to a fixture synthetic repo too.
incidents.signature: A test failed at the gate, not at the behavior it meant to exercise.

incidents.title: A ruling widened a shared valid state and only some payloads followed
incidents.rule: When a ruling widens a shared valid state, change every payload that builds it.
incidents.signature: Some negatives passed against the tip only.

incidents.title: A count change was reconciled by totals and a route switch leaked into the default path
incidents.rule: Explain a count change by file identity, not by totals.
incidents.signature: Totals matched while the contents differed.

incidents.title: A merge of main left an activation due and went red
incidents.rule: A merge of main carries every activation its new markers make due.
incidents.signature: The merge commit was red on its own.

incidents.title: A shape regex was used as ownership evidence for a sweep
incidents.rule: A sweep that decides by shape needs decoys.
incidents.signature: A sweep matched files it did not own.

incidents.title: Card text pointed at its own directory as the checkout
incidents.rule: Grep every card for the executable path; do not keep a duty beside the section that overrides it.
incidents.signature: Cards broke silently when the card set moved.

incidents.title: A production build dirtied the tree and an example role was missing locally
incidents.rule: Check porcelain after every build; verify an example role exists locally.
incidents.signature: The tree was dirty after a successful build.

incidents.title: A chat pre-approval did not lift an explicit approval rule
incidents.rule: When an approval prompt expires, queue and report; never rephrase around the rule.
incidents.signature: An upload stalled on an approval prompt that expired.

incidents.title: A readiness check ran without the dispatcher environment
incidents.rule: Run readiness checks with the live dispatcher environment.
incidents.signature: A missing variable read as a missing tool.

incidents.title: A package launcher in an uninstalled source clone reached for the registry
incidents.rule: Install offline before running a package launcher in a source clone.
incidents.signature: A dispatch hung or failed on a network lookup.

incidents.title: A marker generator covered every payload of a root when only part was approved
incidents.rule: A marker covers only what the ruling approved.
incidents.signature: A marker claimed more than the ruling approved.

incidents.title: Sibling fixture factories lacked the metadata that makes a checker required
incidents.rule: Sibling fixture factories carry the same required metadata.
incidents.signature: A positive control passed without reaching its negative.

incidents.title: A docs-only row was accepted by judgment instead of one mechanical diff
incidents.rule: Accept a docs-only row by one name-status diff against the stated parent.
incidents.signature: Acceptance depended on reading.

incidents.title: Rename detection reported a false rename in a merge
incidents.rule: Do not accept either side of a reported rename; confirm the blob against main.
incidents.signature: A merge showed a rename and delete that did not happen.

incidents.title: A per-root checker summary undercounted edges
incidents.rule: Derive the marker set from the manifests, not from a per-root summary.
incidents.signature: The summary showed fewer edges than the manifests hold.

incidents.title: A slow stage was trimmed by cases instead of cut by grouping files
incidents.rule: Group files that parallelize cleanly; do not trim cases whose timeouts are fixed.
incidents.signature: A stage kept growing while case trimming saved little.

incidents.title: An override changed the lockfile and an offline clone could not install it
incidents.rule: Warm override metadata with a frozen install in a scratch clone before any offline install
incidents.signature: An offline install failed for lack of supply-chain metadata.

incidents.title: An override was written without reading the dependent declared range
incidents.rule: Read the dependent declared range in the registry before writing an override; an out of range override needs a direct probe of the code path
incidents.signature: An override landed outside the range the dependent declares.

incidents.title: FAST stayed green while a command-adapter fixture missed a new execution project
incidents.rule: Update every command-adapter fixture when an execution project is added, and do not trust FAST alone
incidents.signature: Only the FULL path caught the missing project.

incidents.title: A one-parser requirement was pinned by only one kind of test
incidents.rule: Pin a one-parser requirement both structurally and behaviorally
incidents.signature: A second parser could appear without failing a test.

incidents.title: A rehearsal mixed automatic guards with procedural stops
incidents.rule: Separate automatic guards from procedural stops in a rehearsal, and plant the state change relative to the actual baseline
incidents.signature: The rehearsal could not say which guard fired.

incidents.title: A negative grep was taken as proof that a removal ruling was complete
incidents.rule: Check each named duty and its follow-through lines; a negative grep alone proves nothing
incidents.signature: The forbidden token was gone and the duty remained.

incidents.title: A citation check by search alone could miss a changed fact
incidents.rule: Compare cited ranges by diff when a version bump moves pinned-source citations
incidents.signature: A moved range was matched by text while its behavior changed.

incidents.title: A single stage time on a loaded host was read as a measurement
incidents.rule: Decide timing rules on repeated runs with the load recorded, never on one stage time
incidents.signature: The same tree read 30.5 s and then 14.9 s.

incidents.title: An allowlist fix turned gate tests green while the runner skipped the new project
incidents.rule: Prove a new project ran by its own marker, not only by the shared stage record
incidents.signature: The gate tests passed and the new project never ran.

incidents.title: A typecheck failed in a shared helper the revision did not own
incidents.rule: Fix a shared helper in its own row, never inside the consumer root
incidents.signature: The red was in code the revision could not touch.

incidents.title: A ledger derived from a token range went stale when a row joined the range
incidents.rule: Regenerate a ledger derived from a range at each revision and state the derived count
incidents.signature: The ledger no longer matched the plan.

incidents.title: An inline directive could bypass a lint rule on a protected path
incidents.rule: Scope noInlineConfig by files; an ignored directive still prints a warning
incidents.signature: A bypass could be written inline.

incidents.title: A sandbox permission failure was at risk of reading as a code defect
incidents.rule: Treat a permission-denied run as missing evidence and rerun it where it is permitted
incidents.signature: The red had nothing to do with the code.

incidents.title: Two review titles named the wrong reviewer
incidents.rule: Check the attribution line of every report before landing it
incidents.signature: The report carried another reviewer name.

incidents.title: One adapter rejection looked like ten separate defects
incidents.rule: Before triaging many reds, read the child output to find the one shared cause
incidents.signature: Ten failures shared one cause.

incidents.title: A setup failure was at risk of counting as a test run
incidents.rule: Do not count a setup-only failure as a run
incidents.signature: The run failed before any test started.

incidents.title: A precommit check reported a merge-brought approval as unreachable
incidents.rule: Judge reachability on the committed merge, not on the precommit state
incidents.signature: The check read the wrong commit.

incidents.title: A runtime value was at risk of being invented to quiet the compiler
incidents.rule: Copy the typed input and delete from the copy; never fabricate a runtime value to quiet the compiler
incidents.signature: The compiler asked for a value the code should not have.

incidents.title: A guessed commit id was sent to two teammates
incidents.rule: Never cite a commit id in a message before git has printed it
incidents.signature: Two teammates received a wrong id.

incidents.title: Three sends failed because a packed string went out as one argument
incidents.rule: Check the exit status of every send, and pass real arguments, not a packed string
incidents.signature: The sends failed with exit 1.

incidents.title: Two rows were green alone and red together
incidents.rule: Rehearse the merged stack, not the branches
incidents.signature: The combination failed and neither branch did.

incidents.title: A FULL step deadline was shorter than the measured stage time
incidents.rule: Recheck FULL step budgets against measured FAST stage times whenever the suite grows
incidents.signature: The deadline sat below the measured time.

incidents.title: A slow suite was a candidate for cutting before it was profiled
incidents.rule: Profile before cutting tests
incidents.signature: The slow part was not where cuts would land.

incidents.title: A regex literal was read as a file path by the permission checker
incidents.rule: Put probe code in a file inside the scratch tree; prefer plain string tests over regex literals on a command line
incidents.signature: A harmless probe was blocked as a path access.

incidents.title: A relative path was resolved against the wrong root
incidents.rule: Use absolute paths when working across worktrees
incidents.signature: The command was refused for a path it did not name.

incidents.title: A network-denied dependency audit was neither a finding nor a pass
incidents.rule: Classify a network-denied audit by its exact signature, and keep other errors with the same code failing
incidents.signature: The audit could not run and exited like a result.

incidents.title: A helper was fixed and a caller still passed a literal empty object
incidents.rule: Check every caller of a fixed helper with a strict destination compile
incidents.signature: The helper fix left a caller broken.

incidents.title: A commit skipped the machine-wide pre-commit scanner
incidents.rule: Never override the hook path; if it happens, amend with hooks on right away
incidents.signature: The scanner never ran.

incidents.title: A scratch swap of revision bytes failed the identity gate as designed
incidents.rule: Use the real approved chain in a causal proof, not just the bytes
incidents.signature: The gate failed for the right reason, which the proof had not intended.

incidents.title: A fixed test count in an exit criterion went stale
incidents.rule: State an exit as the full active inventory with zero failed or skipped, name the qualifying-run rule, and disclose excluded runs
incidents.signature: The count no longer matched the suite.

incidents.title: Two loaded-host reds shared one cause and were at risk of a timeout bump
incidents.rule: When reds share a cause class that a pending row removes, carry the acceptance to that row, not a timeout or a retry
incidents.signature: The cheap fix hid the shared cause.

incidents.title: A shared host reached load 491 and unrelated deadlines failed
incidents.rule: Cap concurrent heavy runs across the team and record load at start and end
incidents.signature: Unrelated deadlines failed under a shared load.

incidents.title: A reviewer proposed text was at risk of being applied by its own author
incidents.rule: Apply a reviewer exact text through a third party, with digested backups, a proposer re-review and a separate re-check
incidents.signature: The author could soften the reviewer text.

incidents.title: A performance refactor was checked only on the real tree
incidents.rule: Prove a performance refactor with old and new on the same failure fixtures
incidents.signature: Equal output on the real tree hid changed failure behavior.

incidents.title: A clean-tree positive did not exercise the working-file context
incidents.rule: Plant a harmless byte difference before proving a refusal when the baseline is chosen by byte equality
incidents.signature: The clean tree matched the baseline, so the refusal path never ran.

incidents.title: An empty environment caller was at risk of being repaired with inherited values
incidents.rule: Prove the input is empty and that the refusal fails without its guard
incidents.signature: The inherited values hid the empty case.

incidents.title: A classifier kept a legacy pattern list beside a new exact signature
incidents.rule: Probe a classifier extension with lookalike negatives
incidents.signature: The legacy list still matched lookalikes.

incidents.title: A fix was named for one card while four siblings carried the same command
incidents.rule: When applying a fix, search for siblings of the named instance and report them
incidents.signature: The siblings were left unfixed or silently changed.

incidents.title: A hand-made merge could differ from the mechanical merge unnoticed
incidents.rule: Verify a hand-made merge against a mechanical merge of the same parents
incidents.signature: The extra changes sat inside a large merge.

incidents.title: A retry wrapper logged the dependency stderr privately and starved the caller diagnosis
incidents.rule: A wrapper must preserve the failure channel of what it wraps, passing the last cause through on final failure.
incidents.signature: A long outage was reported with an empty cause.

incidents.title: A digest manifest without digests was cited as evidence
incidents.rule: Check that a manifest has one digest per line before citing it
incidents.signature: The manifest looked complete and held no digests.

incidents.title: A commit swept another session uncommitted entries
incidents.rule: In a shared checkout, stage only your own paths and check the log for foreign commits before writing
incidents.signature: Entries landed under a message about a different lesson.

incidents.title: A split of the dominant test file saved about zero
incidents.rule: Profile a dominant file and check shared inventory assertions and the critical path before splitting it
incidents.signature: The split was on the shorter branch of the critical path.

incidents.title: A measurement was at risk of coming from an overlay in a scratch tree
incidents.rule: Measure on the exact tree that carries the file and label every figure with its SHA
incidents.signature: The figures had no tree behind them.

incidents.title: A prompt render succeeded without reading the card bodies
incidents.rule: Verify external card bytes separately from a successful prompt render
incidents.signature: The render referenced the cards by path only.

incidents.title: Approval of role cards in prose was at risk of standing in for a runtime check
incidents.rule: Run the planted-dispute rehearsal and the incomplete-verdict dry run at the exit commit; prose approval is not runtime evidence
incidents.signature: No run backed the approval.

incidents.title: A ledger review that started from the author list could inherit its gaps
incidents.rule: Derive a ledger from the plan yourself before reading the author list, then compare
incidents.signature: The reviewer saw only what the author listed.

incidents.title: A revision review could re-read an unchanged downstream table
incidents.rule: Diff the downstream table first when a revision only adds upstream rows
incidents.signature: The unchanged part cost review time and hid the real delta.

incidents.title: A BLOCKED result came from a deadline before the plant ran
incidents.rule: A negative proof counts only with a passing control, the plant own execution marker and the named failed step
incidents.signature: The negative never reached the plant.

incidents.title: A team runtime cap blocked new teammates behind retained idle ones
incidents.rule: Release then close the longest idle teammate to free a slot; prefer larger batches over more teammates
incidents.signature: The cap was reached with idle teammates that could not be closed.

incidents.title: A leak scanner matched part of a generated name and blocked uploads
incidents.rule: Scan the whole tree after every merge, and fix a scanner false match with an encoded safe prefix proved by planted cases
incidents.signature: The scan failed closed on a merge long after the files were added.

incidents.title: A hold outcome had no proof that nothing changed
incidents.rule: Prove a hold by the remote main SHA unchanged before and after and an empty porcelain on the build clone
incidents.signature: No change looks the same as no run.

incidents.title: An auto-merge of a helper could lose an activation or coverage unnoticed
incidents.rule: Prove an auto-merge by an ordered two-parent history check and an exact-run project inventory
incidents.signature: The bytes were right and a project could still drop out.

incidents.title: Automated tests passed while nobody had walked the real site
incidents.rule: Walk the real site after each milestone and feature close, and write each defect as a failing test first
incidents.signature: The suite covered what was written, not what a person would click.

incidents.title: Four of five test authors stopped at the same undeclared seam
incidents.rule: Audit a proposed test by the seam it declares, and checkpoint per root rather than per batch
incidents.signature: Authors stopped at the same boundary.

incidents.title: A proposed subject was treated as if its seam were declared
incidents.rule: Declare the import seam; ownership or authorization of a subject does not declare a callable boundary
incidents.signature: The missing binding was not declared anywhere.

incidents.title: A correct not-found page was served with a 200 status
incidents.rule: Assert the response status and the rendered body together
incidents.signature: The page looked right and the status was wrong.

incidents.title: A third-party avatar request was made without anyone noticing
incidents.rule: Assert that a page makes no request to a third-party origin unless declared
incidents.signature: The page looked right and still contacted a third party.

incidents.title: A short password check created the one-time account instead of showing an error
incidents.rule: Run destructive checks on a one-time form last, and use a repeatable form for validation checks
incidents.signature: The probe succeeded and consumed the one-time form.

incidents.title: Ancestry was at risk of standing in for a clean tree or a checker run
incidents.rule: Do not use ancestry as evidence of a clean tree, a checker run or bracketing observations
incidents.signature: The commit was there and the facts were not proved.

incidents.title: The env script could not be sourced in zsh
incidents.rule: Run checkers through bash -c when the env script is not zsh-compatible
incidents.signature: The checker ran without its environment.

incidents.title: A cd to a path in a variable was refused by the sandbox
incidents.rule: Use literal paths for cd in a sandbox
incidents.signature: The command was refused although the path was allowed.

incidents.title: Bare angle-bracket slots turned a Markdown note into raw text after structural checks passed
incidents.rule: Verify Markdown by the target renderer's own parse, not by structural lint; never leave a bare <slot> outside code.
incidents.signature: The note passed every structural check and still showed raw text after the first slot.

incidents.title: A QA file was placed where neither the identity checker nor the project would take it
incidents.rule: Every QA brief states the allowed destination prefixes and file suffix
incidents.signature: The file was never collected.

incidents.title: A word grep reported a failure in a passing log
incidents.rule: Count failures from runner summary lines, never from a word match
incidents.signature: A test title contained the word.

incidents.title: Two of four selected projects executed no case
incidents.rule: Record executed cases per project; a selected project is not coverage
incidents.signature: The selection looked like coverage.

incidents.title: Raw evidence was deleted with the scratch area
incidents.rule: Copy raw evidence and logs out of a scratch area before the cleanup runs
incidents.signature: Only extracted tables survived.

incidents.title: One batch finding hid 45 files with the same dependency
incidents.rule: When a finding names a mechanism, sweep the suite for it before fixing one batch, and resolve a design conflict at its source
incidents.signature: The defect was a conflict between two documents, not a batch fault.

incidents.title: Evidence commands ran on a shimmed runtime instead of the pinned one
incidents.rule: Run evidence commands with the pinned binary by absolute path and print its version in the log
incidents.signature: The version reported was not the pinned one.

incidents.title: Moving the home directory broke a launch that found its cache through it
incidents.rule: Name every home-resolved cache explicitly when moving HOME for isolation
incidents.signature: The cache location was implicit.

incidents.title: A failed closing run could leave a signed record public
incidents.rule: Run the exact-closing checks on a local closing record before merging and uploading it
incidents.signature: Publishing came before the closing check.

incidents.title: Sum every runner the earlier record summed
incidents.rule: Compute a total with the same formula as the earlier record, covering every runner
incidents.signature: A reported total omitted one runner.

incidents.title: Prove an alias fix by the exact-SHA run with the default spelling
incidents.rule: Prove a path-alias fix by running the exact SHA with the default spelling and no workaround
incidents.signature: A path-alias fix could be proven only with a workaround in place.

incidents.title: A landed root revision cannot carry its supersession file in the same commit
incidents.rule: Land a root revision first and add its supersession file after the non-author re-check
incidents.signature: A supersession file was planned in the same commit as the root it approves.

incidents.title: Keep local evidence paths out of review text
incidents.rule: Keep local evidence paths out of committed review text
incidents.signature: A review cited a private local folder in committed text.

incidents.title: Refresh the team roster at each phase change
incidents.rule: Refresh the team roster at each phase change so thread IDs and models stay findable
incidents.signature: A team roster went stale for ten rounds.

incidents.title: Run repo checkers from a tree that contains them
incidents.rule: Run a repo checker from a tree that contains it, or fast-forward the tree first
incidents.signature: A checker failed because the tree it ran in lacked its modules.

incidents.title: A rendered not-found view is not proof of a 404 status
incidents.rule: Treat a rendered not-found view as no proof of 404; check the HTTP status once streaming has committed the shell
incidents.signature: A not-found page was rendered with a 200 status.

incidents.title: A planned round with STOP in place proves nothing
incidents.rule: Never count a round as proof while a silent skip gate is in place; verify it actually ran
incidents.signature: A planned round would have been skipped silently by a stop gate.

incidents.title: A check named lint can write
incidents.rule: Do not assume a read-named check is read only; read its loader
incidents.signature: A check named as read only could create directories.

incidents.title: Keep a canary and a mid-stage STOP rehearsal in separate windows
incidents.rule: Do not host a destructive rehearsal inside the run that produces the evidence
incidents.signature: A rehearsal planned inside a canary could have destroyed the canary evidence.

incidents.title: Drop a rehearsal step that needs a missing input channel
incidents.rule: Drop a step that needs a missing channel rather than faking it
incidents.signature: A rehearsal step could only pass if its input was faked.

incidents.title: Restarting a shared dispatcher is the shared owner decision
incidents.rule: Leave a shared service restart to its shared owner
incidents.signature: A team lead could have restarted a shared dispatcher that affects all teams.

incidents.title: A load-induced harness red is not headroom
incidents.rule: Do not count the arithmetic distance to a budget as headroom when later stages never ran
incidents.signature: A run stopped early under load and its remaining time looked like spare budget.

incidents.title: Not-found under a streaming root layout answers 200 whatever the call site
incidents.rule: When a root layout streams its shell, set the status before it, not from the rendered view
incidents.signature: Every call site for a not-found error still returned 200.

incidents.title: A status check must take every client reading
incidents.rule: Take every client reading of a status before calling it fixed
incidents.signature: One client reading of a status disagreed with the others.

incidents.title: Write times from a command output, not from memory
incidents.rule: Write a recorded time from a command output, never from memory
incidents.signature: An evidence line recorded a time that was not read from a clock.

incidents.title: A probe that sends a session cookie alone may test guest behavior
incidents.rule: Send every header an authenticated request needs, and run a control that proves the identity the probe claims
incidents.signature: A probe that sent only a session cookie silently tested guest behavior.

incidents.title: Do not hand-match paths a framework matches with a richer syntax
incidents.rule: Reuse the framework path matcher instead of a hand matcher, or test every syntax form it supports
incidents.signature: A hand matcher understood fewer path forms than the framework it mirrored.

incidents.title: Sign the stable re-checked part of a design addendum instead of waiting
incidents.rule: Unblock parallel work by signing the stable re-checked part of a document and naming what stays held
incidents.signature: Several authors were idle while one open part of a design addendum was pending.

incidents.title: Brace a shell variable that is followed by a colon
incidents.rule: Always brace a shell variable that is followed by a colon
incidents.signature: A shell variable followed by a colon was read as a modifier.

incidents.title: Replacing an active test file moves the replacement, its supersession record and the registry line in one commit
incidents.rule: Move a replacement, its supersession record and its registry line together in one commit when the old file is already active
incidents.signature: A supersession record was refused in both path forms because the replacement had not moved yet.

incidents.title: Never chain a write after a diagnostic
incidents.rule: Never chain a write after a diagnostic with &&; assert the written file exists before trusting later checks
incidents.signature: A write skipped by a failed diagnostic left every later check green.

incidents.title: Confirm the landing commit contains every file before cleaning the source
incidents.rule: Confirm the landing commit contains every file before cleaning the source
incidents.signature: A source was cleaned against a failed commit and its change was reverted.

incidents.title: A test that claims a role must prove the role before relying on it
incidents.rule: Prove the claimed role with a positive identity marker before any check relies on it
incidents.signature: A committed test claimed a staff role while running as a guest.

incidents.title: A hold gate is proven only while eligible work exists
incidents.rule: Prove a hold gate only with eligible work present; an empty queue proves nothing
incidents.signature: A hold looked proven when the queue had nothing to select.

incidents.title: A gate result counts only at a revision the gate can fetch and that holds its fix
incidents.rule: A gate run counts only at a revision the gate's clone can fetch and that already contains the fix the gate depends on
incidents.signature: A gate passed at a revision that did not yet hold the fix it depended on.

incidents.title: A tier-level coverage table hides untraced cases
incidents.rule: Trace coverage per case, never per tier
incidents.signature: A coverage table summarized a tier while individual cases had no trace.

incidents.title: Fix module resolution once at the root, not per test
incidents.rule: Resolve a shared dependency once at the root and keep test roots on plain imports
incidents.signature: Each test root worked around the same missing dependency in its own way.

incidents.title: An oracle that matches a substring or a loose boundary can be satisfied by a decoy
incidents.rule: Prove a claim on the exact element or attribute, and show the oracle rejects a decoy
incidents.signature: An assertion passed on a decoy that merely contained the expected text.

incidents.title: Verify a worktree can run the required checks before assigning work there
incidents.rule: Confirm a worktree can run the required checks before work is assigned there
incidents.signature: Every required check failed before running because the assigned worktree lacked a script.

incidents.title: A passing identity check was taken as agreement with the signed plan
incidents.rule: Identity validity is not plan agreement; compare the resolved owner with the signed plan
incidents.signature: A file resolved to the wrong owner while its identity check passed.

incidents.title: A setup hook was sized from file time, or from a refused attempt
incidents.rule: Measure the hook itself, count only runs that executed, and mark owed measurements as owed
incidents.signature: A hook timeout was chosen without measuring the hook itself.

incidents.title: A known unrelated load timeout blocked a row until one combined run accepted both
incidents.rule: When the only failure is a known unrelated load timeout with a fix in flight, one passing run on the combined merge accepts both rows
incidents.signature: A branch gate failed only on a known unrelated timeout under heavy load.

incidents.title: A snapshot recorder that finished was taken as proof it had collected
incidents.rule: Completion is not collection; require per-observation status and distinguish empty from failed
incidents.signature: A recorder reached its completion message while observations were missing.

incidents.title: The before-state was not preserved before an operator edit
incidents.rule: Preserve before-state bytes before an operator edit; a later snapshot cannot recreate them
incidents.signature: A later snapshot could not recreate the state from before an operator edit.

incidents.title: Activating a replacement over the only file in a directory removed the directory
incidents.rule: Before a remove-and-move, check whether the file is alone in its directory, and run pending checks first
incidents.signature: A move failed halfway because removing the sole file removed its parent.

incidents.title: A pure move onto an existing path was read from the diff's rename display
incidents.rule: Prove a move by byte equality and digests, not by the rename display
incidents.signature: A move showed as modify plus delete, so the diff could not confirm it.

incidents.title: Plan line anchors drifted with each plan version
incidents.rule: Cite plan rows by identity; line drift alone is not a finding
incidents.signature: Correct line citations became off by one after a later plan revision.

incidents.title: A test needed a second account that the minimal seed did not create
incidents.rule: Check each test's seed needs against the seed its declared dependencies provide
incidents.signature: Cases looked up a second admin account that the seed lacked.

incidents.title: Harness and ownership defects were left for the build agent to find
incidents.rule: Run a red check before the build agent starts and classify each first failure
incidents.signature: Defects unrelated to the product were found only after the build started.

incidents.title: A row-only overlay left out the helpers of a dependency row, so consumers looked blocked
incidents.rule: Confirm the helpers owned by dependency rows are active in the base before judging a consumer blocked or red
incidents.signature: Consumer files failed to import helpers that a declared dependency owns.

incidents.title: A ruling presumed the result its check would show
incidents.rule: A ruling prescribes the remedy and the check, never the result the check must show
incidents.signature: A ruling stated that the next check must show a particular failure.

incidents.title: An offline lockfile regeneration carried an unrelated stale resolution
incidents.rule: Keep a dependency change to the ruled lines and prove it with a frozen install
incidents.signature: A regenerated lockfile changed entries the ruling did not cover.

incidents.title: A plan revision left stale operative text that only an independent review caught
incidents.rule: After a revision, check every operative sentence and count against the replacement, using a reviewer who did not write it
incidents.signature: A revised plan still directed work to a superseded file and carried wrong counts.

incidents.title: A guard added to a test tool broke the check under test
incidents.rule: Test a guard added to a test tool against a known good page, and bisect the tool's options when a page that works by hand fails
incidents.signature: A page that works by hand rendered empty under the test tool.

incidents.title: A test was about to move to satisfy a dependency without reading what it asserts
incidents.rule: A dependency edge does not justify moving a test; check what it asserts and what acceptance the move would remove
incidents.signature: A proposed move would have removed the only browser acceptance for two rows.

incidents.title: A process the sandbox could not see was judged dead and its live run was removed
incidents.rule: A process your sandbox cannot see is not a dead process; ownership comes from your own run record, not from visibility or timing
incidents.signature: A run directory vanished mid run after another agent removed a registration it judged dead.

incidents.title: A conditional diagnosis was closed from the actor's account and the code path
incidents.rule: Do not open a fix row for a hazard that is only conditional; close on the confirmed cause and track the hazard as a follow-up
incidents.signature: A diagnosis named only conditional hazards, yet the incident needed a cause.

incidents.title: A measurement wrapper inherited the environment the tests replace
incidents.rule: A wrapper that only adds reporting uses fixed absolute tool paths and reads no variable the tests set or replace; an invalid invocation is kept but is neither a red nor a measurement
incidents.signature: A timing wrapper found its tool through variables the tests replace on purpose, so runs failed before measuring anything.

incidents.title: A fixed stage deadline met planned case growth that nobody had projected
incidents.rule: When an acceptance checklist adds cases to a bounded stage, project the stage time per rung and decide who re-measures before the load, not after the first timeout
incidents.signature: A stage deadline measured at 24 cases was about to carry 105.

incidents.title: A helper tool's argument meaning was misread by its own author
incidents.rule: Read a tool's usage line before a destructive mode, even your own tool; keep destructive steps in tools that verify the kind of each argument
incidents.signature: A digest was passed where the clean step expected a commit, and a tracked file was deleted.

incidents.title: A coverage ledger keyed on report names missed a scoped run of the exact bytes
incidents.rule: Key coverage ledgers on the exact bytes executed, from any report, not on report names
incidents.signature: The ledger called a red check stale while a reviewer had already executed the exact terminal file.

incidents.title: Moving tests into a new group silently dropped them from callers that select the old group by name
incidents.rule: Before re-routing tests between groups, list every caller that selects the group by name and prove each still selects the same files
incidents.signature: A proposed move would have made every selector that names the old group omit the moved files.

incidents.title: A whole stage was divided by a parallel speedup although part of it had to stay serial
incidents.rule: Model a parallelised stage as serial work plus parallel makespan plus new cold starts, never as total time over N
incidents.signature: A projected stage time divided the serial files by the speedup too.

incidents.title: Tests in a parallel group raced a test that drops the shared inventory
incidents.rule: A test that creates shared resources goes in a serial group with no concurrent inventory reader; a focused single-file run is not evidence of isolation
incidents.signature: A single-file run passed or failed alone while the full parallel run could race.

incidents.title: A probe-based test never ran its probe, so its red proved nothing about the probe
incidents.rule: Add a positive control that goes green on current code before trusting a red from new probe machinery
incidents.signature: The test was red on the feature assertion without the probe ever executing.

incidents.title: A static checker's PASS was read as acceptance without an anchored baseline
incidents.rule: A static tool's PASS is labeled as static and anchored to recorded hashes; it never stands in for runtime or acceptance
incidents.signature: An identity PASS appeared with no recorded hash behind the supplied baseline.

incidents.title: A recursive diff of a copied tree followed fixture symlinks into the host
incidents.rule: Verify copied trees with a manifest that does not follow symlinks; fixtures point symlinks at fixture-owned targets
incidents.signature: A copy check wandered outside the copied tree and hit sockets and pipes.

incidents.title: Finished teammates sat unnoticed because their completion replies never arrived
incidents.rule: Never wait on a reply alone: when an output file stops changing and no reply came, check the run status and land from disk
incidents.signature: Work was complete on disk while the coordinator was still waiting for a message.

incidents.title: A path guard probed only with nonexistent paths could never fail
incidents.rule: Negative targets must exist; pair every guard with a positive control that must return the other value, and run one selftest on the real unpatched checker
incidents.signature: Every negative target returned allowed because the probed paths did not exist.

incidents.title: A sparse checkout hid a tracked file that every brief pointed at
incidents.rule: When a brief points at a repo file, confirm it exists in each reviewer's checkout, including sparse lists
incidents.signature: A reviewer reported a tracked file absent from the tree.

incidents.title: A positive control's first red was the control's own defect
incidents.rule: When a new positive control fails, suspect the control first, fix it as a tests-only commit and keep the red
incidents.signature: The control failed because its captured environment overwrote a value the nested runner set.

incidents.title: A green parallel run was cited although the parallel group held no files
incidents.rule: Count the population a mode actually runs before citing its green; while it is empty, proof comes from forced-overlap probes
incidents.signature: The parallel pass was green over zero files.

incidents.title: A search helper ended a gather loop at the first file without a match
incidents.rule: In loops, use a tool whose no-match status you control (append a guard) and check that every iteration printed
incidents.signature: A loop printed results for some inputs and silently skipped the rest.

incidents.title: A red run that also renamed its checks counted name drift as defects
incidents.rule: A red-first run that also renames checks shows real behavioural reds per fix, paired with aggregate and exit evidence, never a bare failure count
incidents.signature: A large failure count included checks that failed only because they were renamed.

incidents.title: A periodic status sweep took the index lock of a teammate's worktree
incidents.rule: A monitor of someone else's worktree must be lock free (no index refresh) or not touch that worktree at all; never delete a lock you did not create
incidents.signature: A teammate's staging step failed on a lock created by the coordinator's monitor.

incidents.title: A background watcher lacked the session credentials and failed every poll
incidents.rule: Check what a background watcher can authenticate to before relying on it; keep authenticated checks in live turns and never write a session secret to disk
incidents.signature: A watcher reported nothing because every poll was refused.

incidents.title: A signer recomputed the declared digest before signing and kept the signature outside the hashed range
incidents.rule: A signature binds to bytes the signer has hashed himself, and appending the signature must not change the hashed range
incidents.signature: A declared digest was about to be signed without the signer having hashed the bytes.

incidents.title: A marker checker matched a bare word and pushed authors to a workaround
incidents.rule: Anchor a marker check on call syntax, not a bare word; when a checker false positive forces a workaround, record it and fix the checker rather than spreading workarounds
incidents.signature: A checker reported many focused-test markers that were only object keys.

incidents.title: A selector mirroring a config's exclusions matched basenames at any depth
incidents.rule: When code mirrors a config's file selection, compare anchored paths, not basenames, and keep an executable union check with planted nested witnesses
incidents.signature: Files in nested directories with an excluded name vanished from a selection the config would keep.

incidents.title: A pool saturation probe waited on a connection its own adapter retained
incidents.rule: Measure saturation against max minus what the code under test already retains, and never read a timeout as capacity evidence without the acquired and retained counts
incidents.signature: A probe timed out at full pool size and the timeout was read as exhaustion.

incidents.title: A runbook described steps its own script's gate refused
incidents.rule: Walk every runbook step through the script's gates offline before calling the runbook ready
incidents.signature: The documented run record failed the script's gate because the gate wanted a second record with other keys.

incidents.title: A job edited a file outside its brief
incidents.rule: Name the only files a job may touch, and check the diff file list on landing
incidents.signature: A commit changed a file the brief never named.

incidents.title: A tier exclusion matched only one file extension
incidents.rule: When tiering by filename suffix, check the exclusion glob against every extension in use and keep a discovery witness per tier (absent here, exactly once there)
incidents.signature: Slow proofs moved to a differently suffixed file would have stayed in the per-commit tier.

incidents.title: A per-commit stage cost more than doubled before anyone sampled it
incidents.rule: When a row adds tests to a shared per-commit gate, sample the stage early and compare with the design assumption; move heavy proofs to the slower tier rather than raising the cap
incidents.signature: The first stage sample came after several review rounds and showed far more than the design assumed.

incidents.title: A bare number beside a time threshold invited a unit misread
incidents.rule: Put units in every numeric cell that sits near a time threshold
incidents.signature: A count was readable as seconds because the cell had no unit.

incidents.title: A pinned base digest froze a file that a later row split needed to change
incidents.rule: When prepared patches pin a file's digest, treat that file as frozen and route every change through a later patch with the same regenerate caveat
incidents.signature: A needed edit to a file would have invalidated the digest that prepared patches pin.

incidents.title: A tier exclusion was added only after a witness failed without it
incidents.rule: A config change that moves tests between tiers needs a red witness first, the same as a code change
incidents.signature: A configuration change had a witness that was red before and green after.

incidents.title: Reviewers named at ruling time were busy when the artifact landed
incidents.rule: Name the reviewer when the artifact lands, from whoever is free and is not its author; record the reassignment in the ruling
incidents.signature: A review was reassigned because the reviewer named earlier was occupied.

incidents.title: A review pinned before the fix reported findings that were already closed
incidents.rule: When a review's pin is older than the latest fix, land it with a note naming the commit and review that supersede each stale finding
incidents.signature: A review of an older checkpoint listed findings as open that had since been fixed and closed.

incidents.title: A mutant of a shared helper proved sensitivity but not the real resource's end state
incidents.rule: A helper mutant proves the test can see the bug; a real-resource witness proves the resource ends in the right state; when both are claimed, require both
incidents.signature: Cheap fake-client controls went red, yet nothing showed the real pool ended in the right state after a failure.

incidents.title: A fixture that linked the host dependency tree let the package manager rewrite it
incidents.rule: Never link a writable host dependency tree into a fixture that runs the package manager; if unavoidable, turn auto-install off explicitly in the fixture environment and add a guard that fails when the host tree's listing changes
incidents.signature: A fixture's package manager run pruned the linked host dependency tree and turned 11 failures into 51.

incidents.title: A registration subject pinned to the current local head read as stale under a push freeze
incidents.rule: Under a push freeze, pin the subject by role and corroborate the freeze with a remote query (one tip query does not prove the history); a stale remote-tracking ref is not freeze evidence
incidents.signature: An owner packet asserted checkout, clone and remote at one hash, and the assertion went stale only because local commits accumulated.

incidents.title: A shortcut launcher lacked the protection the canonical entry supplies implicitly
incidents.rule: Close a gate only through the canonical entry; a shortcut launcher may lack protections the canonical path supplies implicitly
incidents.signature: A gate was run by starting the test runner directly, and a nested fixture's package manager then pruned the host dependency tree.

incidents.title: A weakened final check survived a contract suite that lacked the right-signal, wrong-detail case
incidents.rule: When a mutant survives, add the cell where the coarse signal is right and the checked detail is wrong, and rerun the mutant to prove the cell kills it
incidents.signature: Weakening a final title check survived an offline response-contract suite because no case left the title wrong while the status looked right.

incidents.title: Focused runs after a refactor hid static-check residue until the first canonical run
incidents.rule: After a refactor, run the canonical gate once, static steps included, before more focused work; focused runs skip lint, typecheck and hygiene checks
incidents.signature: Many commits were verified with focused runs, and the first canonical runs failed at lint and a hygiene check before any suite ran.

incidents.title: A timing anchor derived by subtraction was used as if it were a measurement
incidents.rule: Replace a derived timing anchor with a measured one as soon as the thing exists, and recompute every threshold it feeds
incidents.signature: A budget model anchored on a stage time obtained by subtraction, while quiet measured samples were higher.

incidents.title: A ruling sent in a message was never written to the ruling log
incidents.rule: Write a ruling into the log in the same step as sending it; a ruling that exists only in a message is invisible to every other reader
incidents.signature: A reviewer found a ruling missing from the log, and it had to be reconstructed from message text with a caveat.

incidents.title: A final print in a wrapper replaced the command's failure with success
incidents.rule: In a wrapper, save the exit status on the very next line and end with an explicit exit of it; prove a nonzero child makes the wrapper nonzero
incidents.signature: A generated run script ended with a print statement and no explicit exit, so a red gate returned zero.

incidents.title: A deadline set at twice the slowest sample was budgeted against the whole deadline
incidents.rule: When a rule demands margin k, the budget is the deadline divided by k; track the slowest sample against that, not the deadline
incidents.signature: A stage was projected safe until it reached its deadline, while one sample already broke the real binding line.

incidents.title: A revision was overwritten in place and its recorded digest named bytes that no longer existed
incidents.rule: A digest proves which bytes you meant, not that you can still run them; keep every reviewed revision's bytes until the fix lands
incidents.signature: A rechecker could not run the new tests against the prior revision because only its size and digest survived.

incidents.title: Time stamps written from an estimate ran ahead of the clock
incidents.rule: Read the clock immediately before writing any time stamp; when you did not, write a bounded range from the last real reads, never an estimate
incidents.signature: Four rulings were labelled 19:35 to 19:50 while the clock read 19:26 at the next check.

incidents.title: A physical copy of a shared package store carried its registry of outside links
incidents.rule: Before copying a shared tool cache into an isolated run, list its links; a registry of outside links is metadata to exclude, while any other outside link is a containment failure
incidents.signature: A preparation check that no copied link resolves outside the copy stopped the first authorized run before setup.

incidents.title: A size limit on each transported record and a full-identity requirement were specified together with no framing
incidents.rule: When a transport limit and a completeness requirement meet, specify the framing and reconstruction, and test with long and non-ASCII identities
incidents.signature: A timing spec required every record to fit 512 bytes and to carry full file and case identity, and a long path could not satisfy both.

incidents.title: An authorization point was placed after the first event that needs the identity
incidents.rule: Put the authorization point before the first event that must carry the identity, and test the forged-object negative
incidents.signature: A spec required records emitted early in a run to carry an identifier that was not created until later in the run.

incidents.title: Gating by an environment variable leaked into nested runners that copy the environment
incidents.rule: Never treat an inherited environment variable as authority; bind it to the process that was authorized
incidents.signature: A spec claimed an opt-in feature was inert in nested child runs, but a nested helper copied the whole environment and started a fresh runner directly.

incidents.title: Per-item sequential timeouts could not meet a global deadline stated in the spec
incidents.rule: When a spec sets a global bound, check the existing per-item loop arithmetic; sequential waits add up
incidents.signature: A spec required every process group to be reaped within 10 s, while the shutdown code waited on the groups one after another at about 10 s each.

incidents.title: A reviewed recipe never ran its real tool queries because every control stubbed them
incidents.rule: A stubbed control proves the recipe's logic, not its commands; before an authorized run, execute every real read-only command once against the pinned tool versions
incidents.signature: A recipe passed its dry run, control run and copy cases, then its first real run stopped in preparation on an unsupported option.

incidents.title: A landing helper piped a guarded commit into a formatter, so the guard's failure did not stop the cleanup
incidents.rule: Never pipe a gating command into a formatter in a chain whose later steps destroy the input; check the gate's own exit status
incidents.signature: A scrub guard failed, yet the helper went on to delete the source file because the pipeline reported the formatter's zero status.

incidents.title: A restated rule gained a qualifier the original ruling never had
incidents.rule: When a ruling is restated in a spec, copy its population word for word; a qualifier borrowed from another purpose narrows an alarm, so diff every restated condition against the ruling's own words and fix each sibling copy
incidents.signature: A ruling said to report every sample over a limit at once, but the spec that restated it said to report only eligible samples.

incidents.title: A stored admission record left out the tool versions it was produced under
incidents.rule: A stored proof that unlocks a faster or riskier route must carry the tool versions it was produced under and compare them at use; a mismatch or a missing field takes the safe route with a named reason, never the fast one
incidents.signature: A per-file audit that admits concurrent test runs recorded no tool versions, so a proof from one toolchain would unlock the fast route under another.

incidents.title: Ownership registered before a create made a definite duplicate error drop a foreign database
incidents.rule: Ownership recorded before a create covers an uncertain outcome only; on a definite already-exists error release the claim before rethrowing, and test with a pre-existing object under the exact name
incidents.signature: A harness queued a drop of its test database before creating it, so a create that failed because the name existed would drop a database it never made.

incidents.title: A test's teardown emptied a shared server database, and a gate that never completed hid the red
incidents.rule: A test that mutates shared state must restore the baseline its successors expect (reset then reseed, never reset only), and the harness should re-establish and check that baseline when each shared step starts; a slow gate with no recorded completion since two tests landed has not tested them together, so treat the main line as unproven until it runs
incidents.signature: A late end-to-end step could not log in because an earlier test's teardown had deleted the seeded accounts from the shared server database.

incidents.title: A landing loop written for one shell's arrays ran under another and committed one of two files
incidents.rule: Iterate arrays with an explicit form valid in the running shell (the quoted all-elements expansion), and derive a commit message from the committed diff summary after the commit, not from intent
incidents.signature: A commit message claimed two files but only the first of the two was committed.

incidents.title: A module-presence guard went through the test's own file-system mock, so a missing-API label was never proven
incidents.rule: Before counting a red as missing-API, prove the guard both ways (module present: silent; module absent: fires), and never route a presence check through a mock the same test installs
incidents.signature: Tests labelled as missing-API reds still failed at the same guard after the module existed.

incidents.title: A hand-written landing chain swallowed a failed post-commit leak scan and three commits landed on top
incidents.rule: Print the exit status of every commit and check step explicitly (never only on success), run the range leak scan before landing anything on top of a new commit, and use the guarded landing helper, not an ad-hoc chain
incidents.signature: A landing step printed nothing and the chain moved on, although the script it ran had exited non-zero.

incidents.title: A delegated test run needed login and logout, which delegates may not do, so the lead ran the pinned script
incidents.rule: When a test needs an action above a delegate's permission ceiling, the delegate writes and statically validates the script and pins its hash and exact command; the lead runs it unchanged and returns the artifacts; never weaken the test to fit the ceiling, and never let the delegate claim a result it did not observe
incidents.signature: A delegate prepared a browser walk that logs in and out but the runtime refused it for delegated agents.

incidents.title: A walk checklist attached another request variant's clause to the keyless request, so a correct response read as a failure
incidents.rule: Derive each checklist expectation verbatim from the delivered spec row and cite the row; triage every failure against the spec, the code and the active tests before calling it a defect
incidents.signature: A walk reported one failure on a response that matched the delivered spec.

incidents.title: A brief for a database-backed run omitted the test database endpoint, so the delegate rightly stopped
incidents.rule: A brief that asks for a runtime run must carry its runtime environment (the exact endpoint and environment variables, which slot is free, the load gate, and what must never be touched); a delegate that finds a required environment value missing stops and asks, never infers one
incidents.signature: A delegate stopped before a database-backed run and reported a missing environment variable.

incidents.title: A new worktree symlinked its dependency trees to another worktree's, and the package manager relinked through them
incidents.rule: Never share a dependency tree between worktrees by symlink; give each worktree a private clone; never run the package manager unless the exact command is authorized; keep the verify-before-run settings off for every child; compare the full link inventory against a clean sibling after any suspected mutation
incidents.signature: A package manager command in one worktree changed the dependency links of another worktree.

incidents.title: A bare syntax check resolved to a different runtime that ignored the flag and executed the script
incidents.rule: Run syntax checks with the pinned binary by absolute path, and make every script that can act externally refuse at its first line without its required environment
incidents.signature: A syntax-check command executed the script it was meant only to parse.

incidents.title: A scrub command was refused as a broad home-directory scan by the operating system's privacy layer
incidents.rule: Scope searches to tracked files in your own tree; never scan the home directory
incidents.signature: A search step was refused by the operating system as a scan of the whole home directory.

incidents.title: A byte-count compare at the exact old length reported end of file on a prefix that matched
incidents.rule: Verify append-only files with an explicit byte-prefix compare, not a limited-length compare at the exact length
incidents.signature: A prefix check on an append-only file exited non-zero although the old bytes were unchanged.

incidents.title: A test run's command-line exclusion flag did not take effect, so excluded cases ran and called the package manager
incidents.rule: List the collected files before a filtered run and stop if any excluded file is still collected
incidents.signature: Cases that were meant to be excluded from a run executed anyway.

incidents.title: Two replies were stamped with times ahead of the clock
incidents.rule: Read the clock immediately before writing any timestamp, never estimate it
incidents.signature: Replies carried a time stamp later than the moment they were sent.

incidents.title: A clause-survival script flagged 21 digest rules that a word diff showed were only wording compressions
incidents.rule: Run a word diff before treating a flagged rule as lost
incidents.signature: A clause-survival check flagged many rules as lost although their meaning was intact.

incidents.title: An engineer overwrote its own unit ledger with a later run
incidents.rule: Keep a ledger append-only with a dated section per run; never overwrite it with a later run
incidents.signature: A ledger file held only the latest run after an engineer wrote a new run over it.

incidents.title: A signed design heading outranked a plan census parenthetical when two reviews disagreed on a file location
incidents.rule: When reviews disagree on a file location, read the signed design text first; it outranks a plan parenthetical
incidents.signature: Two reviews gave different locations for the same file.

incidents.title: A draft test root was revised in place after review, marker or activation
incidents.rule: Revise a draft test root in place only while it has no review, marker or activation; after that only a successor
incidents.signature: A root that others had reviewed or marked could be edited in place.

incidents.title: A default that silently let a guard pass made a reviewer read a requirement as met
incidents.rule: A guard must fail closed with an explicit configuration error; never let a default make it pass
incidents.signature: A guard passed on an input it had never been told about.

incidents.title: Splitting a review's amendments kept the engineer busy while decisions were pending
incidents.rule: Split a review's amendments into apply-now and author-decides, and write no tests for undecided items early
incidents.signature: An engineer would have waited for all amendments of one review to be decided.

incidents.title: A landing helper's clean step deleted a pending root directory and left an unchanged tracked file deleted after the fast-forward
incidents.rule: A clean step must not leave a tracked unchanged file deleted; restore tracked files after a fast-forward and check tree status
incidents.signature: A tracked file that had not changed was gone after a landing.

incidents.title: A whole-tree content digest detected a dependency change but could not say which file
incidents.rule: Record a marker-time file list as well as the whole-tree digest, so a change can be attributed to a file
incidents.signature: A digest differed from the marker value and gave no hint which file changed.

incidents.title: A click-around walk that always exits 1 from a known gap cannot gate regressions
incidents.rule: Compare a walk with a known gap against a named baseline result; an exit code that is always failing cannot gate
incidents.signature: A walk reported failure on every run, so a new failure was indistinguishable.

incidents.title: A ruling was stamped four minutes ahead of the clock because the time was written before the clock was read
incidents.rule: Read the clock first, then write the time, in that order within the step
incidents.signature: A ruling carried a time stamp later than the moment it was written.

incidents.title: The lead stamped a brief four minutes ahead of the clock again, one round after the same correction
incidents.rule: A failure that repeats after a written rule needs a mechanism: generate the time from the clock, never type it
incidents.signature: A brief carried a time stamp later than the moment it was written, after a rule against it was already recorded.

incidents.title: Two engineers answered the same STOP diagnosis independently, and agreeing answers let the lead route at once
incidents.rule: When a STOP cause is unknown, ask for two independent static answers before routing the fix
incidents.signature: A STOP had an unknown cause and a single diagnosis would have been unchecked.

incidents.title: A path-identity guard compared strings while a temp directory has two spellings on the host
incidents.rule: A path-identity guard compares real paths, never strings
incidents.signature: Two spellings of one directory compared unequal.

incidents.title: One review asked to delete an error-text assertion while another asked to pin the text
incidents.rule: Pin an error name, never message text, as the oracle
incidents.signature: Two reviews gave opposite instructions about the same assertion.

incidents.title: A baseline comparison graded only rows present in the baseline, so a new failing row passed
incidents.rule: A baseline comparison must grade a row new in the run on its own outcome
incidents.signature: A run with a new failing row compared equal to its baseline.

incidents.title: Two plan checks ran at a wrong script path and the last line of their output looked like a result
incidents.rule: Match the explicit pass line of a check, never its last line
incidents.signature: A crashed check ended with a line that resembled a result.

incidents.title: A dispatch packet written for a future branch went stale when a later ruling started the work elsewhere
incidents.rule: Reconcile a dispatch packet with the newest ruling when it lands
incidents.signature: A packet named a branch and checkout that a later ruling had superseded.

incidents.title: An implementer's evidence admitted one case that contradicted its own every-undeclared-case-throws rule
incidents.rule: When evidence contradicts a stated rule, the rule wins: change the code, not the wording
incidents.signature: The evidence listed a case the stated rule said could not exist.

incidents.title: A declaration request that split sourced values from decisions let the lead rule eleven items in one pass
incidents.rule: Request declarations as sourced values and decisions, each with its gap
incidents.signature: A request mixed facts and open choices, which would have needed several rounds.

incidents.title: A load reading taken minutes before a launch was stale, and the launch read much higher
incidents.rule: Gate on load where you launch, immediately before; an earlier or second-hand reading is stale
incidents.signature: A load gate passed from a reading that no longer described the host.

incidents.title: A security predicate checked for truthiness failed open on an undefined or null value
incidents.rule: A security predicate allows only on the exact expected value, never on truthiness
incidents.signature: A guard allowed access when its input was missing.

incidents.title: Handing a counting stream to a framework that catches stream failures lost the custom refusal contract
incidents.rule: Own the refusal contract before handing a stream to a framework that catches stream failures
incidents.signature: A custom refusal never reached the caller once the framework wrapped the stream.

incidents.title: A multi-step command reported success for its later steps while its middle step had not happened
incidents.rule: Verify each landing by the commit log, never by the last line of the command
incidents.signature: A command's final output said done while one step had never run.

incidents.title: A pending root whose supersession line said review pending failed the identity checker at landing
incidents.rule: Land a pending successor without its marker; write the marker only after the review
incidents.signature: The identity checker rejected a landing whose marker line said approval was pending.

incidents.title: A content inventory that hashed every file under the dependency tree stopped a clean run because the test runner rewrote its result cache there
incidents.rule: Exempt exactly one named path from a content inventory, with its digests recorded; never a directory or pattern
incidents.signature: An inventory guard failed a clean run because one cache file changed.

incidents.title: A final review was reassigned from a busy reviewer to an idle one of a different model instead of queueing
incidents.rule: Reassign a review to an idle qualified reviewer of a different model rather than queueing it, keeping the non-author rule
incidents.signature: A review waiting for a busy reviewer would have stalled the acceptance step.

incidents.title: An activation instruction to delete superseded pending copies had nothing to delete because an earlier pure rename had already moved them
incidents.rule: Before a delete step in an activation, check the file exists; a prior pure rename leaves nothing to delete, so record that
incidents.signature: An instruction assumed pending copies still existed after they had been renamed away.

incidents.title: A dispatch packet called a root absent an hour after it had landed
incidents.rule: A conditional packet must re-read the newest main for every root it names before review
incidents.signature: A packet stated a root was absent when it was already present on main.

incidents.title: An author who received a ruling mid-run superseded its own earlier status with a dated addendum without rewriting the historical bytes
incidents.rule: When a ruling changes a status, append a dated addendum that supersedes it; never rewrite the historical bytes
incidents.signature: A status written before a ruling needed to change after it.

incidents.title: The identity checker allowed a successor root's new path with no predecessor line, and a marker maps only replaced paths
incidents.rule: A marker maps only replaced paths; a successor's new path needs no predecessor line
incidents.signature: A successor root added a path that had no earlier copy, and it was unclear whether a marker line was owed.

incidents.title: A safe default could silently drop data when an uncertain state was read as gone
incidents.rule: When a state is uncertain, treat the item as surviving; fail closed, never read a refusal as gone
incidents.signature: A safe default treated a refused read as an absent item.

incidents.title: The demo server served a build made before the merge, so a walk after a source merge would have observed nothing new
incidents.rule: A milestone walk needs a fresh build of the merged SHA on its own port, never the running demo server
incidents.signature: A walk after a merge would have run against a server built before it.

incidents.title: Two load readings around a sub-second run were equal because the host load average updates on a fixed interval
incidents.rule: Equal load readings around a sub-second run are expected from the fixed update interval; record each as read, never copy
incidents.signature: Two readings of host load were identical around a very short run.

incidents.title: A lead signature line containing the assistant's product name failed the scrub
incidents.rule: Sign with a role name; a product name in a signature line fails the scrub
incidents.signature: A signature line failed the scrub.

incidents.title: An evidence gap, a temporary config not retained, was closed by a lead re-run that kept it, not by asking the author to reconstruct it
incidents.rule: Close an evidence gap by a re-run that keeps and records the artifact, not by a reconstruction
incidents.signature: A run's evidence omitted a temporary config that had been deleted.

incidents.title: A landing helper's clean step fast-forwarded a merged feature branch's ref, which would have moved a live branch
incidents.rule: A clean step must never move a branch ref that is still under work
incidents.signature: A clean step changed the ref of a branch that had already been merged, and it could have been one still in use.

incidents.title: The lead re-merged the full candidate itself rather than queue behind the busy owner, and proved the delta path by path
incidents.rule: When the owner is busy, redo a mechanical merge directly and prove the new delta equals the old path by path
incidents.signature: A mechanical merge was waiting for a busy owner.

incidents.title: A red phase may start while a spec recheck runs because the reviewed bytes fix the behavior
incidents.rule: Start the red phase while a spec recheck runs; only the production commit waits
incidents.signature: Work waited for a recheck that could not change the reviewed behavior.

incidents.title: A whole-unit re-run showed five failures in unrelated files because a required environment variable was unset in the shell
incidents.rule: Record failures caused by an unset environment variable as an environment gap, never a pass and never a regression
incidents.signature: A whole-unit run failed in files unrelated to the change under acceptance.

incidents.title: An acceptance document cited a ruling that did not yet exist when it was signed
incidents.rule: A signed record cites only rulings that exist, or says the item is to be ruled
incidents.signature: A signed record referred to a ruling that was not yet written.

incidents.title: A static package-constant check before dispatch found a design constant absent on main
incidents.rule: Before dispatch, check statically that every constant and export the design names exists on main
incidents.signature: A design named a constant that the code on main did not export.

incidents.title: A ruling timestamp was written from an estimate and corrected minutes later, twice in one round
incidents.rule: Read the clock immediately before writing each timestamp; never write one from an estimate
incidents.signature: A ruling carried a time that did not match the clock.

incidents.title: Ten teammate threads showed state paused with complete outputs on disk and no reply message
incidents.rule: Grade a teammate output from the file on disk; a missing reply or a paused state is not a verdict
incidents.signature: A thread showed paused and sent no reply while its output file was complete.

incidents.title: A load gate read and a launch chained in one command let a unit probe start at a load above the gate
incidents.rule: Run the load read and the launch as two separate commands; a reading at or above the gate stops the launch
incidents.signature: A probe started on a host whose load was far above the gate.

incidents.title: The milestone runbook shell-sourced an environment file and failed before the build on a value with angle brackets
incidents.rule: Read an environment file line by line, never shell-source it; a value with angle brackets breaks sourcing
incidents.signature: The runbook failed at its first step on a value the shell parsed as syntax.

incidents.title: A registry edit failed its own sorted-order assertion, and the identity checker refuses a supersession whose old path the registry still names
incidents.rule: Change the registry line and the supersession record whose old path it names in one control commit, and assert the sorted order first
incidents.signature: A registry edit and a supersession record conflicted when landed separately.

incidents.title: A reviewer finding moved a hook registration owner twice in one hour
incidents.rule: Assign a hook registration owner only after reading which row owns the hook's neighbours
incidents.signature: The owner of one registration changed twice in about an hour.

incidents.title: A closure packet freeze test turned positive on a control-only landing and the lead admitted it narrowly
incidents.rule: Admit a freeze-test hit only narrowly: name the landing, why the run cannot read it, and the change that makes it a new STOP; never waive the identity step
incidents.signature: A freeze test reported a change that the guarded run could not read.

incidents.title: A scoped compiler config flagged an import style that the canonical build never compiles
incidents.rule: Check a scoped compiler diagnostic against the canonical build before calling it a defect; fix a scoped-config artifact in the retained config, not the repository
incidents.signature: A scoped compile failed on a file the canonical build does not compile.

incidents.title: A review was reassigned off the critical path so the reviewer who owned the blocking recheck stayed on it
incidents.rule: Keep the reviewer on the critical path on that path and reassign off-path reviews to another non-author
incidents.signature: One reviewer held two reviews while a blocking recheck waited.

incidents.title: A captions upload relation in a spec would have added a media referrer to a collection defined as image-only
incidents.rule: Before adding a relation to a shared collection, check what the collection holds and which referrer lists it joins; defer and record a gap if it does not fit
incidents.signature: A relation targeted a collection that does not accept its content.
